# .gitignore template

**Target path:** `.gitignore`

No placeholders -- use as-is.

## Template

```gitignore
# Python-generated files
__pycache__/
*.py[oc]
build/
dist/
wheels/
*.egg-info

# Testing
.pytest_cache
.ty/
.coverage

# Virtual environments
.venv
activate.sh

# Local
.env
CLAUDE.local.md
.mcp.json
```
